text:
ivy: Quick sync - noticed sample-apps, CLI and SDKs disagree on env var names (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY vs REDWOOD_TOKEN). New hire got stuck on quickstart.

omar: We never finalized. My recommendation: pick REDWOOD_API_KEY as canonical. SDKs should fallback for one release but log a single deprecation warning when non-canonical vars are used.

lucy: Strong +1. Also propose explicit scoping envs REDWOOD_ORG and REDWOOD_PROJECT instead of encoding scope inside the key. Makes CI and local envs easier to reason about.

omar: Rotation story: provide a small CI helper that exchanges long-lived keys (prefix lk_) for short-lived session tokens (prefix st_). Sample script in sampleapps/scripts/ci_exchange.sh. SDKs should treat st_ as preferred for runtime.

ivy: Parity bug: JS SDK currently retries 401 due to generic retry wrapper. We should special-case 401 -> raise AuthFailure with hint "maybe_rotated" and not retry. Telemetry: emit one auth.rotation_suspected per process so ops can detect mass expiries.

lucy: I'll patch Go and add a cred-lint rule to flag deprecated env names in sampleapps. Omar can take JS, Ivy can do Python + sample script.
sdk-bot: link: https://redwood.internal/docs/auth/env-conventions (automated)

ivy: I'll draft a short RFC to standardize env precedence: CLI flag > REDWOOD_API_KEY > legacy vars (warn) > credentials file. Aim to land docs + sample script this week to avoid more onboarding friction.

omar: Ok - will start JS PR for no-retry-on-401 and the warning behaviour.

lucy: Will add cred-lint rule and a short CI check to warn for legacy vars for 30 days then block.

ivy: Thanks all, small coordinated changes should remove most of the onboarding pain :tada:
